zh: 以 1:1 方形画幅构图，制作极简几何平面作品。暖米白纯色背景上，一个大红色实心圆位于画面中部偏右；一条高而窄的近黑色竖向矩形置于左侧前景，遮住圆形左缘，并在圆形上方和下方伸出。右下方放置一条钴蓝色横向矩形，覆盖红圆右下缘并延伸至圆外，位置与黑色竖条分开。三个形状保持清晰硬边和均匀平涂色块，利用竖条、圆形与横条形成方向和尺度对比。四周保留宽阔的米白留白，整体平面化，没有立体光影、纹理、渐变或文字。
en: Compose for a 1:1 square canvas as a minimalist flat geometric artwork. Place a large solid red circle slightly right of center on a warm off-white background. A tall, narrow, near-black vertical rectangle stands in front of its left side, concealing the circle's left edge and extending above and below it. Add a cobalt-blue horizontal rectangle at the lower right, overlapping the circle's lower-right edge and projecting beyond it, separate from the black rectangle. Use crisp hard edges and uniform flat fills. Contrast the vertical bar, circle and horizontal bar through their directions and relative sizes. Preserve generous off-white space around the composition, with no dimensional lighting, texture, gradients or text.
